profile.training: 2D Animation Training at Twenty One Academy
profile.biography:
I'm Shoyen Kaiser Asif, a 2D Animator and Cartoon Designer with over two years of experience in the animation field. I received my 2D animation training at Twenty One Academy and primarily use Adobe Animate CC to create cartoon animations and animation-ready visual assets.

My work includes character design, 2D background illustration, storyboarding, and visual storytelling. I enjoy creating appealing cartoon worlds and helping creative ideas become engaging visual experiences.

I'm interested in collaborating with clients, creators, and animation teams on exciting new projects.
profile.heroStatement: I Bring Stories to Life Through 2D Animation.
profile.heroSupporting: I create cartoon animations, expressive characters, illustrated environments, and visual stories that bring creative ideas to life.

projects.title: Luna 2D Character Model Sheet
projects.shortDescription: Complete turnaround model sheet and facial expression matrix for an animated cartoon heroine.
projects.detailedDescription: Full turn-around package including front, profile, 3/4 views, costume color palettes, and 8 unique facial expression studies. Optimized for rigging and frame-by-frame vector animation.

galleryImages.caption: Standard 8-head height turnaround and expression sheet

projects.productionNotes: Designed with clean vector geometry to allow rapid frame-by-frame asset reuse across different shot angles.

projects.title: Golden Hour Bengali Village Courtyard
projects.shortDescription: Atmospheric 2D environment painting capturing rural Bangladesh at sunset with calm water reflections.
projects.detailedDescription: Hand-painted environment illustration showcasing traditional rural architecture, clay dwellings with corrugated tin roofs, a grand banyan tree, and serene riverside reflections under a golden sunset glow.

galleryImages.caption: Golden hour environment keyframe with atmospheric depth

projects.productionNotes: Multi-plane background separated into foreground flora, midground structures, and sky matte for multi-camera parallax panning.

projects.title: Runaway Rogue: Sequence 14 Storyboards
projects.shortDescription: 12-panel dynamic chase sequence featuring rapid alleyway cuts, low-angle perspective, and shot staging.
projects.detailedDescription: Pre-production storyboard sequence mapping an intense urban parkour pursuit. Outlines camera motion vectors, lens choices (low-angle tracking, high-angle wide, extreme close-up), and kinetic character timing.

galleryImages.caption: Scenes 10.0 to 10.8 with camera trajectory indicators

projects.productionNotes: Created for animatic timing at 24fps with camera pans and speed lines designated for composite layout.

projects.title: Sunflower Village Twilight Gathering
projects.shortDescription: Lush story staging with illuminated cottage lamps, winding hillside path, and twilight town ambiance.
projects.detailedDescription: Keyframe background and character placement depicting an animated dusk scene. Built with rich warm amber lanterns, winding cobblestone paths, and historic clocktower architecture.

galleryImages.caption: Staging keyframe with ambient lighting passes

projects.productionNotes: Staged with warm key light on bakery facade and cool cyan rim light on distant castle fortifications.
